newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT-Angping rates DMCI a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Angping rates DMCI a buy.

text.p: Angping Securities on Wednesday recommended a buy on construction firm DMCI Holdings Inc after the firm signed a water supply joint venture project with Biwater International Ltd of the United Kingdom.
"The company has long been wanting to pursue and actually be part of a project that would generate a healthy, continuous and profitable flow of revenues for the long term ...
"This step should provide strong support for long-term earnings growth," analyst Warren Chua said in a report.
